title: withdrawal.held v1
description: Published on subject withdrawal.held (stream WITHDRAWALS) when a withdrawal is created and its funds are held: the client's request is accepted, nothing is sent to the provider yet. Nats-Msg-Id is <withdrawal_id>.held (one per withdrawal). Carries our IDs (TypeIDs), the amount and the currency only: no destination IBAN, creditor name or remittance text. Those are personal data, and the stream keeps messages for 7 days beyond the database's control; consumers read the details from the database by withdrawal_id. Consumers ignore unknown fields. Hand-written; shared by the Node and Go implementations.

event_id.description: Identifies this business event: the outbox row's ID, the same however often the event is published.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units (cents) as a string of digits, greater than zero.

occurred_at.description: When the withdrawal entered status held (was created).
